{'test_behavior': 'Test that the ebeDivide method creates output array using MathArrays.buildArray with correct field and length\n', 'test_name': 'testEbeDivideCreatesOutputArray\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testEbeDivideCreatesOutputArray() {\n    // Create a field and array vector for testing\n    final Field field = new BigField();\n    final BigDecimal[] data = {BigDecimal.valueOf(10), BigDecimal.valueOf(20), BigDecimal.valueOf(30)};\n    final ArrayFieldVector vector = new ArrayFieldVector<>(field, data);\n    \n    // Create another vector with same dimension\n    final BigDecimal[] data2 = {BigDecimal.valueOf(2), BigDecimal.valueOf(4), BigDecimal.valueOf(5)};\n    final ArrayFieldVector vector2 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(field, data2);\n    \n    // Call the method under test\n    FieldVector result = vector.ebeDivide(vector2);\n    \n    // Verify that result is of correct type and has correct dimension\n    assertTrue(result instanceof ArrayFieldVector);\n    assertEquals(3, result.getDimension());\n    \n    // Verify the division results\n    assertEquals(BigDecimal.valueOf(5), result.getEntry(0)); // 10/2\n    assertEquals(BigDecimal.valueOf(5), result.getEntry(1)); // 20/4\n    assertEquals(BigDecimal.valueOf(6), result.getEntry(2)); // 30/5\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import org.apache.commons.math4.field.Field;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.field.BigField;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.linear.ArrayFieldVector;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.linear.FieldVector;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.util.MathArrays;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.*;\nimport org.junit.Test;'}

{'test_behavior': 'Test that the projection method computes the correct result when vectors have the same dimension and non-zero dot product\n', 'test_name': 'testProjectionWithValidVectors\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testProjectionWithValidVectors() {\n    // Create two vectors with same dimension\n    ArrayFieldVector v1 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(new BigFraction[]{BigFraction.ONE, BigFraction.TWO, BigFraction.valueOf(3)});\n    ArrayFieldVector v2 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(new BigFraction[]{BigFraction.valueOf(2), BigFraction.ONE, BigFraction.valueOf(4)});\n    \n    // Compute projection\n    FieldVector result = v1.projection(v2);\n    \n    // Expected result: v2 * (v1·v2 / v2·v2)\n    // v1·v2 = 1*2 + 2*1 + 3*4 = 2 + 2 + 12 = 16\n    // v2·v2 = 2*2 + 1*1 + 4*4 = 4 + 1 + 16 = 21\n    // Scale factor = 16/21\n    BigFraction scaleFactor = BigFraction.valueOf(16).divide(BigFraction.valueOf(21));\n    BigFraction[] expectedValues = {\n        BigFraction.valueOf(2).multiply(scaleFactor),\n        BigFraction.valueOf(1).multiply(scaleFactor),\n        BigFraction.valueOf(4).multiply(scaleFactor)\n    };\n    \n    FieldVector expected = new ArrayFieldVector<>(expectedValues);\n    \n    // Assert that result matches expected\n    assertEquals(expected, result);\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import org.apache.commons.math4.fraction.BigFraction;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.linear.FieldVector;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;\nimport org.junit.Test;\n'}

{'test_behavior': 'Test that the projection method correctly computes the scalar multiplier \nby dividing the dot product of the vector with itself by the dot product of the vector with itself.\n', 'test_name': 'testScalarMultiplierCalculation\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testScalarMultiplierCalculation() {\n    // Create a simple field vector with known values\n    FieldElement[] elements = {new BigFraction(3), new BigFraction(4)};\n    ArrayFieldVector v1 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(elements);\n    \n    // Create another vector for projection\n    FieldElement[] elements2 = {new BigFraction(1), new BigFraction(2)};\n    ArrayFieldVector v2 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(elements2);\n    \n    // Calculate expected scalar multiplier\n    BigFraction dotProductV1V1 = v1.dotProduct(v1); // 3*3 + 4*4 = 9 + 16 = 25\n    BigFraction dotProductV1V2 = v1.dotProduct(v2); // 3*1 + 4*2 = 3 + 8 = 11\n    BigFraction expectedScalar = dotProductV1V2.divide(dotProductV1V1); // 11/25\n    \n    // Compute the projection\n    FieldVector result = v1.projection(v2);\n    \n    // Verify that the result is correct\n    assertEquals(expectedScalar.multiply(v2.getEntry(0)), result.getEntry(0));\n    assertEquals(expectedScalar.multiply(v2.getEntry(1)), result.getEntry(1));\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import org.apache.commons.math4.fraction.BigFraction;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.linear.ArrayFieldVector;\nimport org.apache.commons.math4.linear.FieldVector;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;\nimport org.junit.Test;\n'}

{'test_behavior': 'Test that the projection method computes the correct result when vectors have the same dimension\n', 'test_name': 'testProjectionSameDimension\n', 'test_code': '@Test\npublic void testProjectionSameDimension() {\n    // Create two vectors with same dimension\n    ArrayFieldVector v1 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(new BigFraction[]{BigFraction.ONE, BigFraction.TWO, BigFraction.valueOf(3)});\n    ArrayFieldVector v2 = new ArrayFieldVector<>(new BigFraction[]{BigFraction.valueOf(2), BigFraction.ONE, BigFraction.valueOf(4)});\n    \n    // Compute projection\n    ArrayFieldVector result = v1.projection(v2);\n    \n    // Expected result: v1.dotProduct(v2) / v2.dotProduct(v2) * v2\n    BigFraction dotProduct = v1.dotProduct(v2);\n    BigFraction v2DotProduct = v2.dotProduct(v2);\n    BigFraction scalar = dotProduct.divide(v2DotProduct);\n    \n    BigFraction[] expectedValues = new BigFraction[3];\n    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {\n        expectedValues[i] = v2.getEntry(i).multiply(scalar);\n    }\n    \n    ArrayFieldVector expected = new ArrayFieldVector<>(expectedValues);\n    \n    // Assert that result matches expected\n    assertEquals(expected, result);\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': 'import org.apache.commons.math4.fraction.BigFraction;\nimport static org.junit.Assert.assertEquals;\nimport org.junit.Test;\n'}
